Cigala Cycling

Cycling & Triathlon Coaching, Bike Tours & Retail

Whether it is to help you improve your cycling and triathlon abilities, to give you the most unforgettable bike tour or to help you shop the right product, Cigala Cycling has you covered.

Coaching →Bike tours
2016Founded in Ireland
1,000+Athletes coached worldwide
700+Cyclists guided on tour
10+Years running tours
10+Years serving customers in Ireland & Europe
★ Read our reviews on Google →
Train smarter, ride faster

Cycling & Triathlon Coaching

Individual, sportive and group coaching from a former pro with 28 years in cycling. Over 1,000 athletes coached worldwide.

Go to coaching site → coaching.cigalacycling.com
Guided road & gravel tours

Tours

Fully supported trips across Europe for over a decade, with 700+ cyclists guided. Official tour operator of top Gran Fondos.

Go to tours site → tours.cigalacycling.com
Ireland's #1 online cycling store

Retail Store

A superb range of cycling and triathlon products, trusted for 10 years by cyclists and athletes in Ireland and across Europe.

Go to retail store → retail.cigalacycling.com
1,000+Athletes coached worldwide
700+Cyclists guided on tour
10+Years running tours
10+Years serving customers in Ireland & Europe
★ Read our reviews on Google →
Our mission

All of your cycling needs at your fingertips

Since its founding in 2016, Cigala Cycling’s mission is to bring all of the cyclist’s needs in one place and make them easily available at your fingertips.

Cigala Cycling was founded by Matteo Cigala when he moved from Italy to Ireland. A former pro cyclist with 28 years in the sport, he combines sports science, racing experience and close links with professional teams to help riders of every level train smarter and ride faster.

  • European Road Champion Gran Fondo
  • UCI Gran Fondo Vice World Champion
  • UCI Gravel Vice World Champion
  • Italian Gravel Champion
  • 200+ race wins

Matteo CigalaHead Coach & Tours Director

Read our story →
